transport: single JSON request on stdin; single JSON response on stdout; local child process
invariants: User mutations use an exclusive lock; scan policy requests may wait up to one second
Stop failure aborts restart
Snapshots omit environment values
Docker engine errors produce unknown state
Batch results are per service and deduplicated
Project rename preserves cwd and identities
Project deletion rechecks activity and unknown state under mutation lock
Project deletion archives records transactionally without touching processes, source, containers or volumes
Restore never starts services or overwrites existing project/service IDs
Deleted project summaries omit private specifications
Observed services expose independent verified capabilities; project end skips original observed runs
Internal capture services are omitted from normal snapshots and skipped by batch control
Capture hooks persist whitelisted identity metadata and conservative structured launch recipes, never raw tool commands/output, complete environments or transcripts
Configured user hooks and a live collector do not prove that an existing desktop thread loaded hooks
capture_start uses a collector startup lock and the registered launch path without nesting the global mutation lock
Observed stop verifies each launcher/descendant identity and never signals shared process groups or the tool shell
configure_observed preserves service/run identity and does not start or stop processes
Restart creates a supervised run in the selected state root only after the old tree and ports are released
Capture opt-out matches normalized cwd exactly and leaves existing services untouched
Cleanup requires integer days in 1..36500 and preserves active/latest runs
Log read and cleanup reject paths outside the manager run log namespace
Collector diagnostics store stage/type/time, never raw exception text
Automatic snapshots read paused service caches without probing; explicit refresh checks only the requested project or all projects and preserves scan policy
Batch scan policy scope is all without ids or selected with a nonempty ids list; updates are atomic and return changed
Service configuration applies display name immediately and saves launch and health changes for the next successful start; a supplied stale config_revision is rejected
Service deletion verifies live state and archives the service, runs and operations without stopping the service

snapshot_fields.service.management: managed | attached (some verified manual capabilities) | observed (no current control)
snapshot_fields.service.can_start: boolean; start is available for the service type and current state
snapshot_fields.service.can_stop: boolean; verified supervisor, container or observed single-service scope
snapshot_fields.service.can_restart: boolean; restart is available, subject to live verification before the operation
snapshot_fields.service.can_logs: boolean; false for observed native processes/tasks
snapshot_fields.capture: null or local collector metadata with computed alive; not a desktop hook reload status
snapshot_fields.service.can_force: boolean; force is available for a verified remaining process scope after a stop failure or a verified controllable container
snapshot_fields.service.capability_reason: null or reason for missing/rejected capability
snapshot_fields.service.automatic_end: boolean; false until original observed service starts through manager
snapshot_fields.service.observation_paused: boolean; the owning project's automatic scan is paused
snapshot_fields.service.last_checked_at: Unix seconds of the last recorded actual check, or null
snapshot_fields.service.state_fresh: boolean; this response contains a fresh probe rather than a cached projection
snapshot_fields.service.configuration: effective settings for the next launch, with environment keys only
snapshot_fields.service.has_pending_configuration: boolean; launch or health changes are waiting for a successful start
snapshot_fields.project.auto_scan: 0 or 1; whether the project permits automatic observation
snapshot_fields.project.pinned: 0 or 1; pinned projects precede regular projects
snapshot_fields.project.capture_enabled: boolean; policy for future hooks in this exact normalized cwd
snapshot_fields.project_sort_preferences: sort_key is name, created_at or running_count; direction is asc or desc
snapshot_fields.capture_diagnostic: null or most recent failure stage/type/at; not proof of callback delivery
